Bill.BriefDescription: Repealing provisions addressing the sale, lease, or conveyance of municipal property in commercial areas to private parties for free public parking facilities in cities with populations over three hundred thousand.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the sale, lease, or conveyance of municipalproperty in commercial areas to private parties for free public parkingfacilities in cities with populations over three hundred thousand; andrepealing RCW 35.87.010, 35.87.020, 35.87.030, and 35.87.040.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The following acts or parts of acts are eachrepealed: RCW 35.87.010 (Sale, lease or conveyance of real property forfree public parking authorized"Municipality" defined) and 1967 ex.s.c 144 s 2; RCW 35.87.020 (Notice of intention to sell, lease or conveyreal property in business areaPostingPublicationPreference rightto purchase or lease) and 1967 ex.s. c 144 s 3; RCW 35.87.030 (Consideration, terms and conditionsReversion)and 1967 ex.s. c 144 s 4; and RCW 35.87.040 (RCW 35.87.020 inapplicable to sale, lease orconveyance to federal government or agency or to the state or any p. 1 HB 1048county, city or political subdivision) and 1967 ex.s. c 144 s 5.
